## Brand rules

- [ ] Square corners. Pills only on buttons and chips.
- [ ] Flat fills. No gradients or shadows, except on mockups and the agreed hero-mark exception (4.1).
- [ ] Gilda Display for headlines, Archivo for body, IBM Plex Mono caps for labels.
- [ ] Sentence-case headlines that end with a full stop. No emoji. No exclamation marks.
- [ ] Branch order olive, anchovy, pepper: Plan #646E2C, Build #8A4B3B, Grow #B8BC32. On Brine use #8E9A3C, #B86A55, #B8BC32. Pepper is never text on cream.
